# The Economic Atlas

> Official economic statistics for 62 economies (GDP, growth, inflation, unemployment, interest rates, trade, public finances and more), republished from the statistics offices, central banks and international bodies that publish them and refreshed automatically. Data only: no forecasts, commentary or advice.

Every figure names its source and series code. These are not our numbers: the source is the authority, and figures can be revised by the publisher. When citing, name the original source and The Economic Atlas, with the page link.

## How the site is organised

- Country pages: https://theeconomicatlas.com/<country>, for example https://theeconomicatlas.com/uk. Each has a plain-HTML table of its latest figures (id key-figures).
- Indicator pages (976): https://theeconomicatlas.com/indicators/<country>-<indicator>, for example https://theeconomicatlas.com/indicators/uk-inflation-rate, with the latest value, full history and source.
- Rankings (12): https://theeconomicatlas.com/rankings, every economy ranked on indicators that compare like for like.
- Machine-readable latest figures, one JSON file per economy: https://theeconomicatlas.com/feeds/<country>.json, for example https://theeconomicatlas.com/feeds/uk.json.
- Methodology by economy: https://theeconomicatlas.com/methodology-by-economy
- Data status (what is current and what is waiting on a publisher): https://theeconomicatlas.com/data-status
- About, sources and how to cite: https://theeconomicatlas.com/about
